src/data/city-cost-data.ts: optional gated fields ccaSource, permitSources, extraFaqs; CCA source constants; COST_TEMPLATE_CSLB_VERIFIED re-verified 2026-09-23 (so every cost page's dateModified is 2026-09-23).

src/data/utility-rate-tracker.ts: two new publicly owned utility records, 'riverside' (RPU) and 'pasadena' (PWP), rate null with the utility's own rate page as source. The tracker page reads rows by name and does not render them.

src/data/city-cost-data.ts: CEC_SB379_DATA constant (California Energy Commission SB 379 platform-status download, data of 2026-08-03) used where a city page does not name its permitting platform.
integration_notes: /solar-cost/<city> pages enter the sitemap automatically from getPublishableCityCostRows(); no sitemap_add needed.
New cost pages are linked from their /solar-companies and /solar-savings twins automatically through CitySiblingLinks once they pass the gate.

Several city sites (fremont.gov, oaklandca.gov) return 403 to direct requests from this environment; their pages and fee PDFs were read through the r.jina.ai reader, which returns the city's own document text. carlsbadca.gov and elcajon.gov fee pages could not be read at all.
